one_line: Ghurid general consolidating power at Gwalior fort, c. 1196 CE, facing the local ruler Sulakshanapala.

appearance.age_look: early 40s, tall and broad-shouldered with a seasoned cavalry commander’s build
appearance.face: oval face with a strong jaw, wheatish-olive complexion, trimmed black beard with a few grey strands along the chin, straight nose, sharp dark eyes under slightly arched brows, default expression calm but intense as if assessing a battlefield
appearance.hair: black hair cut short and neat beneath a tall conical quilted cap (kulah) of dark indigo cloth, the cap wrapped at the base with a narrow muted-red band and a small knot of cloth at the crown
appearance.costume: over a long-sleeved, knee-length quilted coat (kazaghand) of deep indigo-blue with visible vertical stitching and a subtle dull-red piping along the front opening, he wears a sleeveless mail shirt that hangs to mid-thigh, cinched with a broad brown leather belt; beneath this is a light beige cotton tunic and loose, slightly tapered trousers tucked into mid-calf brown leather riding boots with simple stitching; on his forearms are plain steel bracers over fitted beige sleeves, and a dark indigo wool cloak with a simple woven border in muted red and cream is thrown back over his shoulders; a small leather pouch and a ring of keys hang from his belt, and a plain silver band ring is visible on one hand, emphasizing his role as both commander and governor
appearance.signature: a slightly curved Persian-style cavalry sword (shamshir) with a plain steel blade, a simple cross-guard, a dark brown leather-wrapped grip, and a subtly rounded pommel, carried in a dark brown leather scabbard with minimal brass fittings at his left hip

ref_desc: Qutb al-Din Aibak is a tall, broad-shouldered man in his early 40s with a trimmed black beard, short hair under a dark indigo conical cap, wearing an indigo quilted coat with mail over beige tunic and trousers, brown boots, dark indigo cloak, and a plain curved shamshir at his left hip in a brown scabbard, all in deep indigo, muted red, beige, brown leather and dull steel grey tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Qutb al-Din Aibak at Gwalior: a tall, broad-shouldered man in his early 40s with an oval face, wheatish-olive complexion, sharp dark eyes, and a trimmed black beard with a few grey strands. His short black hair is mostly hidden under a tall conical quilted cap of dark indigo cloth with a narrow muted-red band at the base and a small cloth knot at the crown. He wears a long-sleeved, knee-length quilted coat (kazaghand) of deep indigo-blue with vertical stitching and subtle dull-red piping along the front edges, over which sits a sleeveless steel mail shirt hanging to mid-thigh, cinched by a broad brown leather belt. Beneath this, show a light beige cotton tunic and loose beige trousers tucked into mid-calf brown leather riding boots with simple stitching. Add plain steel bracers on his forearms over fitted beige sleeves, and a dark indigo wool cloak with a simple muted red and cream woven border, thrown back off his shoulders to reveal the armour. On his belt hang a small leather pouch and a visible ring of iron keys, and a plain silver band ring is on one hand. At his left hip, clearly show his signature weapon: a slightly curved Persian-style shamshir with a plain steel blade, simple cross-guard, dark brown leather-wrapped grip, and rounded pommel, in a dark brown leather scabbard with minimal brass fittings. Use a restrained palette of deep indigo blue, muted red, beige, brown leather, and dull steel grey, and present him front, side, and back in a consistent heroic yet historically grounded look.
